headline: Earnings per share outpace modest revenue growth
summary_short: Revenue grew 1.9% y/y to $215.9M and diluted EPS rose 16.7% to $0.70 ($0.77 adjusted). Enrollments reached 47,260, up 1.6%.
summary_long: Management says operating performance beat its expectations on strong prospective student interest and retention near historical highs. AIUS enrollments grew 7.5% and USAHS 3.2%, while CTU slipped 0.5%. The company repurchased 0.6M shares for $19.9M with $65.1M left on the program and declared a $0.17 quarterly dividend. The South University acquisition is on track to close as early as April 2027. Q4 adjusted EPS outlook is $0.68 to $0.72.
confidence_notes: Adjusted operating income and adjusted EPS are non-GAAP, reconciled in the release. Outlook assumes stable federal student aid and no material regulatory change, per the release's stated assumptions.

drivers.explanation: Operating income growth plus a lower share count; weighted diluted shares fell to 63.3M from 66.0M per the shard.
Growth came from AIUS (+7.5%) and USAHS (+3.2%), partly offset by a 0.5% decline at CTU.
CEO cites strong prospective student interest and student retention trending near historical highs, with continued investment in student support and technology.
